settings.heading: Step 1. Take at least a 5 minute warm shower to soften the skin
settings.description: - This allows the scrub to provide better consistency and exfoliation.

settings.heading: Step 2. Gently apply the scrub in circular motions.
settings.description:
-By applying in circular motions this provides the best technique to removing dead skin and providing the best exfoliating experience.

-Focus on Elbows, Knees, and Heels where dead skin accumulates.

settings.heading: Step 3. Let the scrubs sit for 2-5 minutes and then rinse thoroughly with water
settings.description: -Allowing the scrub to sit (I like to call it marinating LOL) Will allow the skin to soak up the amazing benefits, scents, and aura of our foaming sugar scrubs.

settings.heading: Step 4. Apply Body oil, Body lotion, or Body Butter on damp skin after shower.
settings.description: -Applying a moisturizer after using an exfoliating scrubs allows the skin to hydrate and lock in the moisture from this spa like experience.

settings.heading: Step 5. For the best results exfoliate at least 2-3 times a week
settings.description: - While you are able to use our Foaming scrubs for everyday use, we do recommend you use them at least 2-3 times a week to see any skin improvements or enhancements.

settings.heading: Fun Facts
settings.description:
1. Improve skin texture and feel.

2. Multi-action cleanse and scrub.

3. Best for normal to oily skin types

settings.heading: Step 1. Take a small amount and apply it to damp skin after a shower.
settings.description: - Applying body oil directly after a shower will allow the oil to lock in the moisture and hydration on the skin.

settings.heading: Step 2. Massage the oil gently into the skin until it is fully absorbed.
settings.description: -Focus on Heels, Elbows, and Knees and apply more where/when needed.

settings.heading: Body Oil Fun Facts
settings.description:
1. You can add a couple of drops of body oil to your bathwater to soften the skin while you soak.

2. You can use body oil as a shaving cream for a smooth hair removal.

3. Body oil is also great to layer with different moisturizers to enhance the fragrance for a longer wear.
